display.purpose: Hero titles and page h1s. Noto Serif Devanagari, 700, clamp up to 3.75rem.

headline.purpose: Section headings. Noto Serif Devanagari, 700, clamp up to 1.875rem.

title.purpose: Card titles and kanda names. Noto Serif Devanagari, 600, 1.25rem.

body.purpose: English prose, descriptions, nav. Inter, 400, 1rem, leading 1.625, capped 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Verse-section markers only (Word Meaning, Translation, verse number). Inter, 600, 0.7rem, 0.08em, uppercase. Not a section eyebrow.

verse-sanskrit.purpose: The Devanagari shloka on the manuscript plaque. Noto Serif Devanagari, 1.15–1.3rem, line-height 2.1, 0.025em. Deep Saffron (light) / Temple Saffron (dark).

verse-itrans.purpose: Romanized transliteration, centered, italic. Noto Serif, 1rem, 1.9.

shadows.name: hover-saffron-glow
shadows.purpose: KandaCard hover lift only. Never at rest.

shadows.name: reading-progress-glow
shadows.purpose: The saffron reading-progress bar's faint glow. State-only.

motion.name: ease-reverent
motion.purpose: Ease-out-quint. Scroll-reveal and glyph-draw. Slow, settled, no bounce.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All reveals, glyph-draw, and the progress bar disable under prefers-reduced-motion (already in globals.css).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Deep Saffron fill, Warm Parchment text. Refined and restrained; the solid primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.98 0.005 75); background: oklch(0.45 0.12 45); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.40 0.12 45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.60 0.10 45); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.60 0.10 45 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Hero CTA
components.description: Signature pill invitation: saffron-tinted fill, saffron border, Deep Saffron text, trailing chevron. Used once per page.
components.html: Begin reading
components.css: .ds-hero-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.45 0.12 45); background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.72 0.16 65) 10%, transparent); border: 1px solid oklch(0.72 0.16 65 / 0.4); border-radius: 9999px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-hero-cta:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.72 0.16 65) 20%, transparent); border-color: oklch(0.72 0.16 65 / 0.6); } .ds-hero-cta:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.60 0.10 45 / 0.5); } .ds-hero-cta svg { transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-hero-cta:hover svg { transform: translateX(2px); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Parchment Surface, hairline ring (not a shadow), rounded-xl. Flat at rest.
components.html:
Title

A short description in body type, capped at a comfortable line length.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 16px; background: oklch(0.97 0.006 75); color: oklch(0.18 0.02 50); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.18 0.02 50 / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-family: "Noto Serif Devanagari", "Noto Serif", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: oklch(0.18 0.02 50); margin: 0; }

components.name: Kanda Card
components.description: Signature featured card. Per-book accent bar (draws in on hover), corner accent wash, hand-line-art glyph in the kanda hue, hover lift + saffron glow. Differentiated by hue + glyph, not identical.
components.html:
Book 1
Bala Kanda
बालकाण्ड

The origins of Rama, his childhood, and the story of his youth.
components.css: .ds-kanda-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 16px; background: oklch(0.97 0.006 75); color: oklch(0.18 0.02 50); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.18 0.02 50 / 0.1); text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-kanda-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.72 0.16 65 / 0.3), 0 10px 15px -3px oklch(0.72 0.16 65 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px oklch(0.72 0.16 65 / 0.1); } .ds-kanda-bar { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 1px; background: var(--kanda-accent); transform: scaleX(0); opacity: 0; transition: transform 0.5s, opacity 0.5s; } .ds-kanda-card:hover .ds-kanda-bar { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 1; } .ds-kanda-wash { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.6; background-image: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--kanda-accent) 8%, transparent), transparent 60%); transition: opacity 0.5s; } .ds-kanda-card:hover .ds-kanda-wash { opacity: 1; } .ds-kanda-head { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-kanda-glyph { display: inline-flex; color: var(--kanda-accent); transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-kanda-glyph svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; } .ds-kanda-card:hover .ds-kanda-glyph { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-kanda-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.25 0.03 50); background: oklch(0.94 0.015 75); border-radius: 26px; } .ds-kanda-title { position: relative; font-family: "Noto Serif Devanagari", "Noto Serif", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-kanda-sub { position: relative; font-family: "Noto Serif Devanagari", "Noto Serif", Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.50 0.02 50 / 0.7); } .ds-kanda-desc { position: relative; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: oklch(0.50 0.02 50); margin: 0; }

components.name: Verse Plaque
components.description: The manuscript surface for a Sanskrit shloka. Saffron wash, corner flourishes, centered Verse Sanskrit with a faint gradient rule beneath. The heart of the reading surface.
components.html: वन्दे वाल्मीकिं वन्दे गुरुं वन्दे
components.css: .ds-verse-plaque { position: relative; border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.72 0.16 65) 5%, transparent); padding: 24px 20px; text-align: center; } .ds-verse-plaque::before, .ds-verse-plaque::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.72 0.16 65); opacity: 0.25; } .ds-verse-plaque::before { top: 8px; left: 8px; border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-top-left-radius: 4px; } .ds-verse-plaque::after { bottom: 8px; right: 8px; border-left: none; border-top: none; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; } .ds-verse-sanskrit { font-family: "Noto Serif Devanagari", "Noto Serif", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 2.1; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: oklch(0.45 0.12 45); word-break: break-word; } .ds-verse-sanskrit::after { content: ""; display: block; margin: 0.75rem auto 0; width: 60%; max-width: 14rem; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, oklch(0.72 0.16 65) 30%, oklch(0.72 0.16 65) 70%, transparent); opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Ornament Divider
components.description: Signature section transition: a centered lotus flourish flanked by saffron gradient rules fading to transparent. Used sparingly — once in the hero, once at a major transition.
components.css: .ds-ornament-divider { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; margin: 2rem 0; color: oklch(0.72 0.16 65); } .ds-ornament-divider::before, .ds-ornament-divider::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, oklch(0.72 0.16 65), transparent); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-ornament-divider svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex: none; }

components.name: Nav Header
components.description: Sticky, backdrop blur for legibility over scroll, Om mark + Devanagari wordmark, quiet hover-to-saffron-tint links. Functional glass, not decorative.
components.html:
Valmiki Ramayana
HomeKaandasJourneyAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.98 0.008 75) 80%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.02 70 / 0.6); } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-om { width: 28px; height: 28px; color: oklch(0.72 0.16 65); } .ds-nav-wordmark { font-family: "Noto Serif Devanagari", "Noto Serif", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.45 0.12 45); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-nav-links a { padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.18 0.02 50); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 10px; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { background: oklch(0.92 0.025 65); } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.60 0.10 45 / 0.5); }

components.name: Reading Progress
components.description: Saffron gradient bar fixed below the header, tracks scroll width. State-only elevation with a faint saffron glow; disabled under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-reading-progress { position: fixed; top: 64px; left: 0; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(to right, oklch(0.45 0.12 45), oklch(0.72 0.16 65)); box-shadow: 0 1px 4px oklch(0.72 0.16 65 / 0.3); border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; transition: width 0.1s linear; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-reading-progress { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: The visual system for a digital home of a sacred text. The feeling is of opening a treasured manuscript in a quiet temple hall: warm parchment, saffron ink, and reverent whitespace. The verse is always the hero; ornament is devotion around it, never decoration competing with it. The palette is a single warm parchment ground with one signature accent — saffron — used sparingly so its rarity carries the reverence. Depth is conveyed by tonal layering and hairline rings, not by shadows; a soft saffron glow appears only as a response to state (hover, focus, reading progress), never as ambient furniture. The system is dual-themed: a Warm Parchment light mode for daytime reading and a Temple Night dark mode for quiet, low-light study, both first-class. A per-book accent system gives each of the six Kaandas its own hue, used only on that book's surfaces — a narrative color device, not a second brand palette. The system explicitly rejects: the cluttered legacy valmikiramayan.net table-of-links aesthetic; generic SaaS/startup landing clichés (cream cards, gradient hero metrics, corporate feel); and over-ornate wedding-invitation kitsch (gold filigree, heavy borders, clip-art motifs).
keyCharacteristics: Warm Parchment ground + single Saffron accent, used sparingly (≤ ~10% of any screen).
Dual-theme: Warm Parchment (light) / Temple Night (dark), both curated.
Noto Serif Devanagari carries all Sanskrit and display headings — the soul of the system.
Per-Kanda accent hues, scoped to each book's surfaces only.
Flat by default; tonal layering + hairline rings for depth; saffron glow on state only.
Manuscript-plaque verse typography with a faint rule beneath each shloka.
Motion is reverent, not theatrical: slow ease-out reveals, glyph draw-on, no bounce.
Reading ergonomics are sacred: 65ch prose, verse line-height 2.1, reduced-motion honored everywhere.

rules.name: The One Saffron Rule
rules.body: Temple Saffron is the single brand accent. It appears on ≤ ~10% of any given screen — the Om mark, one ornament, one rule, one focus ring. Its rarity is the point. If two saffron elements compete, remove one.

rules.name: The Per-Kanda Hue Rule
rules.body: Each Kaanda's accent hue is set via --kanda-accent on a .kanda-{slug} wrapper and used only on that book's surfaces. It is a narrative device, never a second global accent. Do not mix kanda hues on a single surface.

rules.name: The Muted-Stone Rule
rules.body: Muted Stone (oklch(0.50 0.02 50)) is for metadata only. It sits at ~4.0:1 on Warm Parchment, below the 4.5:1 body-text target. Reading content (verse translation, word-meaning, descriptions, body copy) must use Temple Ink. If a text is meant to be read, not glanced at, it is never Muted Stone.

rules.name: The Devanagari-First Rule
rules.body: Noto Serif Devanagari renders every Sanskrit verse and every display/headline/title. The page and the verse share one voice. Inter is for English body and UI only. Never set Sanskrit in Inter, and never set an English display heading in a different serif.

rules.name: The Verse-Breathes Rule
rules.body: Verse Sanskrit uses line-height 2.1 and letter-spacing 0.025em. Verses are read aloud and chanted; give the script room to breathe. Never compress verse leading to body proportions for 'density'.

rules.name: The Label-Not-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The .verse-label (0.7rem, 600, 0.08em, uppercase, with a leading saffron dot) is a verse-section marker only — 'Word Meaning', 'Translation', a verse number. It is not a section eyebrow. Do not put a tiny uppercase tracked kicker above every section heading.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows and glows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, active progress). If a card casts a shadow at rest, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Saffron-Glow-Only Rule
rules.body: The only colored glow in the system is saffron at low alpha. No neutral drop shadows, no colored glows in other hues. Depth-glow is always saffron and always state-triggered.

dos: Do keep Temple Saffron to ≤ ~10% of any screen — one Om mark, one ornament, one rule, one focus ring. Its rarity carries the reverence (The One Saffron Rule).
Do set Sanskrit verses and display headings in Noto Serif Devanagari. The page and the verse share one voice (The Devanagari-First Rule).
Do give verse Sanskrit line-height 2.1 and letter-spacing 0.025em. Verses are chanted; let them breathe (The Verse-Breathes Rule).
Do scope each Kaanda's accent hue via .kanda-{slug} + --kanda-accent, on that book's surfaces only (The Per-Kanda Hue Rule).
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; reserve the saffron glow for hover/focus/progress state (The Flat-By-Default Rule).
Do define cards with ring-1 ring-foreground/10 (a hairline ring), not a drop shadow.
Do use the .verse-label only for verse-section markers, never as a section eyebrow (The Label-Not-Eyebrow Rule).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion everywhere — reveals, glyph-draw, and the progress bar all have instant/crossfade alternatives.
Do use OKLCH for every color value. The project is OKLCH-only.
Do cap reading prose at 65–75ch and use text-wrap: balance on h1–h3, text-wrap: pretty on long prose.
donts: Don't use Muted Stone (oklch(0.50 0.02 50)) for reading content — verse translation, word-meaning, descriptions, or body copy. It sits at ~4.0:1 on Warm Parchment, below the 4.5:1 body-text target. Reading content uses Temple Ink (The Muted-Stone Rule). The verse .verse-meaning is a known candidate for a contrast bump.
Don't reproduce the legacy valmikiramayan.net — cluttered, dated table-of-links Web-1.0 with no reading rhythm or atmosphere.
Don't ship generic SaaS / startup landing clichés — cream cards in a grid, gradient hero metric tiles, corporate product-marketing feel. This is a sacred text, not a thing being sold.

Don't use over-ornate wedding-invitation kitsch — excessive gold filigree, heavy borders, clip-art motifs, skeuomorphic parchment-scroll effects. Ornament that decorates the chrome cheapens the sacred.

Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored side-stripe accent on cards, list items, or callouts. The kanda accent uses a full-width top bar and a corner wash, never a side stripe.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient (gradient text). Emphasis comes from weight or size in a single solid color.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The header's backdrop-blur is functional (legibility over scroll), not a card aesthetic.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section. The .verse-label is a verse-section marker, not a section kicker (The Label-Not-Eyebrow Rule).
Don't set Sanskrit in Inter, or an English display heading in a different serif. The Devanagari-first pairing is non-negotiable.
Don't mix two kanda hues on a single surface, or promote a kanda hue to a global accent. They are narrative, per-book only.
